verdict.rationale:
Runloop provides devbox sandboxes with explicit vendor tutorials for running coding agents (e.g. OpenAI Agents SDK, OpenCode, Browserbase/Kernel browser agents) plus generic 'running agents on sandboxes' guides, agent mounts, and a deploy-agent GitHub Action, showing a real recipe-based workflow for agent execution inside sandboxes. However, no vendor documentation specifically names Claude Code or Codex as supported agents with a dedicated recipe/tutorial.
missing for 10: explicit Claude Code and/or Codex integration tutorial, independent hands-on confirmation of running those specific agents.
